name: Shri Venkatesh Refineries Limi
summary: Shri Venkatesh Refineries Ltd. primarily focuses on processing and preserving edible oils, with a strong emphasis on soybean and cottonseed varieties. Its operational cycle involves acquiring raw oil, which is then refined, packaged, and distributed for sale. Beyond its core refining activities, the company also trades various edible oils, including soybean, cottonseed, and palm oil. This enterprise was established on January 28, 2003, and its main office is situated in Jalgaon, India.
